limitations.nestedSchema: Loom: closed discriminated model schemas with arrays, refs and conditionals require accepted nested NodeSchema delivery; no flat-schema registration.
limitations.scheduler: Loom/Concierge: durable run callbacks, host admission and history synchronization are pending; default admission refuses.
limitations.review: Loom/Courier: authorized media-aware review input pending; text filenames and fixture stubs do not prove review.
limitations.pricing: Watt: exact purpose/parameters, fresh account pricing and aggregate ledger approval required for every paid proof; no override for unknown/stale prices.
limitations.media: Courier: opaque durable media producer, selected/owned inputs and bounded saved-artifact transport pending; no frame handles as durable refs.
